Mung Beans Instant Pot Recipe (with Step by Step Photos)

Instant Pot, Lunch

Jump To Recipe Print Tips
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:26
Instaread
When you wake up in the morning and see that your mung beans and rice are ready –  pure, simple happiness. This recipe is about how to cook perfect non-sticky mung beans and rice together in an Instant Pot using the pot-in-pot method with a delay timer. You just need the 5 minutes of prep time for this recipe, and the rest of the work will be done by the Instant Pot.

Preparation Time:5 minutes + 30 minutes Soaking time
Cooking Time:12 minutes
Serves:2
Print Recipe
Cooking Measurements
Ingredients:
1/2 cup dry Mung Beans (Moong Beans)
1/2 cup Rice
Salt, to taste
Water, as needed

Directions:
  1. If you don’t want to use a delay timer, make sure to soak mung beans and rice for at least 30 minutes prior to proceeding, as it will help in digestibility and also make them softer.
  2. Take 1/2 cup dried mung beans in a pot and rinse them well with cold water. Add 1 cup of water to the pot (1 part beans: 2 parts water). If you like, you can add a pinch of salt as well.
  3. Take 1/2 cup of rice in another pot and rinse well with water until the water looks clear. Add 1 cup of water (1 part rice: 2 parts water). If you prefer, add salt to the rice.
  4. Pour 1-2 glasses of water and a stand in the inner pot of an Instant Pot.
  5. Place the rice pot over the stand.

  6. And then on top of that, put the mung bean pot.
  7. Close the Instant Pot with a lid and set the valve to the sealing position. Set the cooking mode on high pressure for 12 minutes (you can do 8 minutes as well for a little al dente texture) and then set the delay timer for 7-8 hours (or a minimum of 30 minutes).
  8. Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes. After that, you can remove the lid. (If you are using the 7-8 hours delay timer method, rice and moong beans will be ready by the time you wake up.) Mung beans are ready; you can see they are fluffy and soft. You can use them to make mung beans bhel chaat, salad, soup, curry, or even mash them and use them in paratha dough (for extra protein).
  9. Rice is ready; each grain looks fluffy and separated. You can use rice as the base to make pulav, vagharelo bhat, curd rice, etc, or serve it with the mung beans curry.

Tips and Variations:
  • Soak mung beans and rice for at least 30 minutes, as it will help in even cooking and also make them easy to digest.
  • This recipe is for pot-in-pot method cooking. If you are cooking moong beans directly in the inner pot (without the pot-in-pot method), reduce the cooking time to 4 minutes.
Taste: Mild Salty
Serving Ideas: You can serve salted boiled mung beans as a side dish, or use them to make mung bean curry,  add them to soup, or make a salad.
